en.title: Club and Contingent Grouping
en.excerpt: How Archeris identifies club affiliations to organize Men Team, Women Team, and Mixed Team divisions.

toc.text: Managing Multiple Teams per Club (Team A, Team B)

en.content:
Team Event Classifications

Team events allow clubs, schools, and regional contingents to compete collectively. Archeris supports three official team formats:

  • Men's Team (Beregu Putra): 3 male athletes from the same club in the same division.
  • Women's Team (Beregu Putri): 3 female athletes from the same club in the same division.
  • Mixed Team: 1 male athlete and 1 female athlete from the same club in the same division.

Automated Club Matching

The system analyzes the Club Name metadata provided during athlete registration to automatically group eligible teammates without requiring duplicate signups.

Team Composition Standards

All members of a team must be registered in the identical bow division and age category (e.g., all 3 archers must be in Recurve U-15 Men).

Managing Multiple Teams per Club (Team A, Team B)

If a club has 6 eligible archers in a single category, Archeris can create Club Team A (ranked 1-3) and Club Team B (ranked 4-6) to maximize participation opportunities.
